name: Regression Tests

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
  pull_request:
    branches: [main]
  workflow_dispatch:

jobs:
  regression:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    strategy:
      matrix:
        python-version: [3.8, 3.9, 3.10, 3.11, 3.12]
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up Python ${{ matrix.python-version }}
        uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: ${{ matrix.python-version }}

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: |
          python -m pip install --upgrade pip
          pip install -e .[dev]

      - name: Run regression tests
        run: |
          pytest -m regression --junitxml=reports/junit-${{ matrix.python-version }}.xml
        env:
          PYTHONUNBUFFERED: 1

      - name: Upload test results to Datadog
        uses: DataDog/junit-upload-github-action@055560f63c405095e9228ba443eee7987e22bb94
        with:
          api_key: ${{ secrets.DD_API_KEY }}
          site: datadoghq.com
          files: reports/junit-${{ matrix.python-version }}.xml
          auto-discovery: true
          ignored-paths: |
            **/tests/*
          concurrency: 1
          node-version: ${{ matrix.python-version }}
          tags: |
            ci
            regression
          service: edgartools
          env: production
          logs: false
          datadog-ci-version: 1.0.0

      - name: Upload test results to Codecov
        uses: codecov/test-results-action@v1
        with:
          token: ${{ secrets.CODECOV_TOKEN }}
          directory: reports
          flags: regression
          name: regression-tests

      - name: Test summary
        uses: test-summary/action@v2
        with:
          paths: reports/junit-${{ matrix.python-version }}.xml
          output: summary-${{ matrix.python-version }}.txt
          show: true
          folded: false

      - name: Show test results in GitHub UI
        uses: dorny/test-reporter@v1
        with:
          artifact: regression-test-results
          name: Regression Test Results
          path: reports/junit-${{ matrix.python-version }}.xml
          reporter: junit
          list-suites: true
          list-tests: true
          max-annotations: 50
          fail-on-error: true
          fail-on-empty: true
          only-summary: false
